note: Reviewed features: feature -> expected behaviour -> test coverage. Definitions only; status, evidence and deployed inclusion are DERIVED (derive_features.py, verify_release.py). A customer-facing change that is not a verified fix for a gap is allowed through THIS route when its feature has an approved review by a named reviewer with a reference, a stated expected behaviour, and test coverage (required rows in the assertion catalog, or new rows for a catalog version that exists). No feature is invented: the list is empty until the owner and reviewer add entries (see templates/feature-entry.template.json).

expectedBehaviour.summary: An explicitly enabled private test session can bind the owned terminal Focus status chain to its session without retaining transcript or objective text.
expectedBehaviour.criteria: For AHT-02 and AHT-03, the enabled diagnostic exposes only ordered hashes and status counts from the owned successful Focus publication; normal sessions expose nothing, invalid or capacity-exhausted work publishes nothing, and the witness never delays save or finalization.
